decisive_spans.text: Bone marrow smear and tissue showed trilineage hematopoiesis with histiocytes and hemophagocytosis
Markedly expanded paracortex (CD3+ T cells), limited CD20+ B cells in residual reactive follicles, positive CD68 and myeloperoxidase in histiocytes

response.rationale: D3 is strongly supported by direct evidence of hemophagocytosis in bone marrow and specific immunohistochemical findings in lymph node biopsy. D1 has some supporting evidence but lacks the definitive findings seen for D3.
